macros.name: cn
macros.doc: Indicates a constant (such as true or nil).

macros.name: DeclarePseudoComment
macros.doc: Used to declare a macro that expands to a comment.

macros.name: DeclarePseudoConstant
macros.doc: Used to declare a macro that expands to a constant.

macros.name: DeclarePseudoFunction
macros.doc: Used to declare a macro that expands to a function.

macros.name: DeclarePseudoIdentifier
macros.doc: Used to declare a macro that expands to a identifier.

macros.name: DeclarePseudoKeyword
macros.doc: Used to declare a macro that expands to a keyword.

macros.name: DeclarePseudoNormal
macros.doc: Used to declare a macro that expands to normal text.

macros.name: DeclarePseudoProcedure
macros.doc: Used to declare a macro that expands to a procedure.

macros.name: DeclarePseudoString
macros.doc: Used to declare a macro that expands to a string.

macros.name: dts
macros.doc: A two-dot ellipsis, for use in the Wirth interval notation 1 . . n, typeset as Graham, Knuth, and Patashnik did in Concrete Mathematics [3].

macros.name: fn
macros.doc: Indicates a function name, such as length, and is initially more or less an alias for \id.

macros.name: hd
macros.doc: Typesets a procedure signature, like \pr, but is intended for use as a header for a procedure, rather than a procedure call.

macros.name: id
macros.doc: Indicates an identifier, and is simply an alias for \textit wrapped in \textnormal.

macros.name: nf
macros.doc: Switch to the normal font (i.e., without bold or italics, etc.).

macros.name: pr
macros.doc: Indicates a procedure name, such as Quicksort, and is initially more or less an alias for \cn.

macros.name: pseudodefinestyle
macros.doc: Used to define “styles” or meta-keys, i.e., shortcuts for setting several keys to given values (used, e.g., to define starred).

macros.name: pseudohl
macros.doc: Initially, the \pseudohl command that is inserted is simply a \rowcolor that uses hl-color, but you’re free to redefine this command to whatever you’d like.

macros.name: pseudoset
macros.doc: Used to set the configuration keys of the pseudo package (using l3keys with pseudo as the module).

macros.name: RestorePseudoBackslash
macros.doc: Switches the definition of \\ to the one used by pseudo.

macros.name: rng
macros.doc: Used to typeset a range, slice or subarray, or simply to indicate the indices of an array, similar to \dts, but using a colon rather than two dots placed horizontally.

macros.name: st
macros.doc: Typesets ⟨string⟩ with added quotes using \stfont.

macros.name: tn
macros.doc: An alias for \textnormal, to break out of the font set using the font key, for inserting ordinary prose between the keywords.
